Qurovo Vercel Website Testing – UI/UX
Bugs Identified By: Parth
Recommended Solutions By: ChatGPT (OpenAI) FOR SIMPLER SOLUTIONS
Document Purpose
This document outlines UI/UX issues identified during testing of the Qurovo Vercel website.
Each observation includes the current issue and a recommended solution to improve
usability, visual hierarchy, accessibility, consistency, and overall conversion.
Major Bugs
Major Bug #1 – Left Align the Hero Section CTA
Current Issue: The hero CTA group is not aligned with the left edge of the heading,
description, and search bar.
Recommended Fix: Left align the CTA group with the rest of the hero content for a
consistent visual hierarchy.

Major Bug #2 – Navigation Bar CTA Draws Too Much Attention
Current Issue: The navigation CTA visually dominates the header.
Recommended Fix: Use a blue outline button instead of a filled button.

-- 1 of 5 --

Major Bug #3 – Missing Descriptions in Homepage Sections
Current Issue: Treatments, Departments, Doctors, and Hospitals lack supporting
descriptions.
Recommended Fix: Add concise one-line descriptions beneath each heading.
Major Bug #4 – Missing Healthcare Context in Section Titles
Current Issue: Generic titles don't immediately communicate healthcare context.
Recommended Fix: Use titles such as Specialist Doctors, Medical Treatments, etc.

Major Bug #5 – Inconsistency Between 'Partner with Qurovo' & 'Qurovo
Intelligence' Cards
Current Issue: The two promotional cards feel like different design systems.
Recommended Fix: Standardize spacing, typography, CTA style, proportions, and layout.

-- 2 of 5 --

Major Bug #6 – Empty Footer Column Creates an Unbalanced Layout
Current Issue: One footer column is empty leaving unnecessary whitespace.
Recommended Fix: Fill it with useful links or redistribute existing columns.
Major Bug #7 – Excessive 'Top Procedures & Treatments' Links
Current Issue: Too many footer links affect UX and internal linking.
Recommended Fix: Reduce visible links and move the rest to a View All page.

Major Bug #8 – Primary Hero CTA Is Not Connected to the Value Proposition
Current Issue: The search bar separates the hero copy from the primary CTA.
Recommended Fix: Place the CTA immediately after the description or make search the
primary action.
Major Bug #9 – Incorrect Visual Hierarchy on Hospital Details Page
Current Issue: The address is emphasized while trust badges are visually weak.
Recommended Fix: Reduce address emphasis and make trust badges more prominent.
Major Bug #10 – Font Size Is Too Small on the Hospital Details Page
Current Issue: Typography reduces readability.
Recommended Fix: Increase body font size and maintain consistent hierarchy.

Major Bug #11 – Remove Unnecessary Icons from Treatment Page Dropdown
Section
Current Issue: Icons add clutter without improving usability.
Recommended Fix: Remove redundant icons and keep only the accordion indicator.
Major Bug #12 – Inconsistent Header Design Across Detail Pages
Current Issue: Treatment page headers use icons while other detail pages do not.
Recommended Fix: Standardize the header design across all detail pages.
Minor Bugs
Minor Bug #1 – Excessive Hover Contrast on 'Get a Callback' CTA
Recommended Fix: Use a subtle hover state instead of a high-contrast effect.

Minor Bug #2 – Icon Inconsistency
Recommended Fix: Use a single icon system across 'How It Works' and 'Why Patients
Choose Qurovo?'.
Minor Bug #3 – Unnecessary Hover Effect on Testimonials
Recommended Fix: Remove hover interactions from non-clickable testimonial cards.
UI/UX Improvements
Improvement #1 – Reconsider Compare Checkbox on Hospital Cards
Recommendation: Show the compare option contextually instead of permanently.

-- 4 of 5 --

Improvement #2 – Add 'Scroll to View All Hospitals' Indicator
Recommendation: Provide a subtle cue encouraging users to continue scrolling.

Major Bugs: 12
Minor Bugs: 3

Total Observations: 17
